A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

GOOD
QUESTIONS.

Let’s talk
Which programme is right for us?

Tell us who the programme is for, your sport and what you want to achieve. Our team can discuss the options for an individual player, preschool, school, club, community organisation or retirement village.

Do you offer more than football?

Yes. Football is at our core, and our coaches also deliver futsal, basketball, hockey, touch rugby and cricket, with netball and other sports in our holiday programmes. Get in touch with your sport and the coaching you need.

How big is the Proteus team?

Nearly 60 coaches delivered programmes across Christchurch in the first quarter of 2026, supporting hundreds of athletes every week across schools, clubs, early learning centres and community programmes.
